scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @homelab/server -w @homelab/web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w @homelab/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run start -w @homelab/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run lint:wrappers
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run test:e2e -w @homelab/server
